description: This file defines the TipsModel class used in the Android client of Nextcloud Notes, representing a tip with associated text and optional action intent.

classes.name: TipsModel
classes.description: A model class representing a tip with a string resource ID and an optional action intent.

methods.name: TipsModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TipsModel with a string resource ID and an optional intent.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the string resource ID for the tip text.

methods.name: getActionIntent
methods.description: Returns the optional intent associated with the tip.
